instructions.name: cross_chain_deposit_and_bridge
docs: Authenticated BNB/DLN ingress, native Gamma deposit accounting, and
dePort share send in one atomic Gamma instruction. The bridging logic and
the deBridge SDK are compiled only under the non-default `cross-chain`
feature; the default (production) build keeps this entrypoint present but
hard-disabled (it rejects before any state transition).

accounts.name: cross_chain_intent
docs: Heap-boxed to keep Anchor's generated account parser below the SBF
4 KiB stack-frame limit without changing the ordered account ABI.

accounts.name: extcall_authority
docs: DLN's externally supplied CPI signer. Hook expense/reward funds
first-use rent and the exact native fee transferred to Gamma's sender.

accounts.name: cross_chain_sender
docs: only when calling deBridge. The handler verifies owner and data before
funding it with the live native fixed fee.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposit assets and receive shares instantly.
Requires NAV to be fresh (within nav_max_staleness).

accounts.name: signer
docs: Signer initializing the GlobalConfig. MUST be the program's
BPFLoaderUpgradeable upgrade authority (proven by the constraints on
`program` + `program_data` below). Becomes the super_admin; the only
later rotation path is `update_admin_authorities`, which is likewise
gated on the upgrade authority. On a fresh deploy, call init BEFORE
finalizing the program (a finalized/`--final` program has no upgrade
authority → init AND rotation impossible) and while a plain deployer
keypair (not a multisig PDA) still holds it.

accounts.name: global_config
docs: Global config account. Derived with a single str.

accounts.name: program
docs: This program's own account; ties `program_data` to this program so the
upgrade-authority check below cannot be satisfied with an unrelated
program's ProgramData.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: ProgramData account holding the program's upgrade authority. Gate: the
signer must equal the upgrade authority. `programdata_address()` returns
`Ok(None)` for a non-upgradeable load and a revoked authority is `None`,
so a `None` on either side fails closed.

instructions.name: initialize_cross_chain_config
docs: Initialize Gamma's program-owned cross-chain control plane. The
existing Gamma upgrade authority is the only initializer and the
circuit breaker always starts paused.

instructions.name: receive_cross_chain_withdrawal
docs: Future withdrawal intake shape. The handler and route configuration
remain independently hard-disabled until the continuation is complete.

instructions.name: set_deposit_policy
docs: Configure the hard shared deposit capacity or pause deposits. The
policy applies equally to native and cross-chain deposit callers.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Payer for initializing the policy on pre-upgrade vaults.

instructions.name: set_fee_config
docs: Configure or disable performance fee settings.

accounts.name: fund_authority
docs: Operator / fund authority.

accounts.name: fee_recipient_account
docs: Token account that will receive fee shares.
Required when enabling fees (performance_fee_bps > 0) or when
mid-window settlement is needed (accrued fees must be settled
to the old recipient before changing config).
Omit when disabling with no accrued fees.
Mutable because it may be the destination of a MintTo CPI during mid-window settlement.

instructions.name: set_keeper_authority
docs: Set or remove the keeper authority on a vault.
When set, this key can call fulfill_withdrawal in addition to fund_authority.

instructions.name: update_admin_authorities
docs: Rotate super_admin, create_authority, and permissioned_creation
atomically. Recovery instruction gated on the program's
BPFLoaderUpgradeable upgrade authority (NOT the current super_admin),
so a compromised or lost super_admin can be replaced.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Signer rotating the authorities. MUST be the program's
BPFLoaderUpgradeable upgrade authority (proven by the constraints on
`program` + `program_data` below).

accounts.name: global_config
docs: The global config account being rotated. Unique in the program.
Deliberately no `has_one = super_admin`: see the struct docs.

accounts.name: program
docs: This program's own account; ties `program_data` to this program so the
upgrade-authority check below cannot be satisfied with an unrelated
program's ProgramData.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: ProgramData account holding the program's upgrade authority. Gate: the
signer must equal the upgrade authority. `programdata_address()` returns
`Ok(None)` for a non-upgradeable load and a revoked authority is `None`,
so a `None` on either side fails closed.

accounts.name: super_admin
docs: The signer must be the global_config super_admin.

accounts.name: global_config
docs: The global config account. Unique in the program.

instructions.name: update_nav
docs: Update the vault's NAV. Called by fund_authority (operator).

accounts.name: fund_authority

instructions.name: update_nav_checked
docs: Atomically update NAV only when the vault still matches the state read
by the caller. This prevents deposits, withdrawals, fee assessments, or
another NAV publish from invalidating an off-chain NAV calculation
between preflight and transaction execution.

If vault has sufficient liquidity: instant withdrawal.
If illiquid: creates WithdrawReceipt, shares go to pending account.

types.name: CrossChainConfig
docs: Program-wide administration for Gamma-owned cross-chain entrypoints.
Initialization is upgrade-authority gated and always starts paused.

fields.name: deposits_paused
docs: Global deposit-only circuit breaker. Withdrawal intake has its own hard
executable gate and remains unavailable in this release.

fields.name: beneficiary
docs: BNB recipient of the managed deAsset. This is order payload data; DLN's
public Solana metadata does not prove it is the source transaction maker.

fields.name: source_token
docs: Declared hook payload value only. The published ExtcallMeta layout does
not expose the DLN CreatedOrder giveOffer, so this field cannot prove
which BNB token funded the order.

fields.name: deposit_amount
docs: Declared destination take-token tranche. This is not the BNB
CreatedOrder give amount, which may use different decimals and terms.

fields.name: min_bnb_shares
docs: Minimum shares after deBridge transfer fees.

fields.name: native_sender
docs: Gamma-derived signer recorded by deBridge as `nativeSender`.

fields.name: kind
docs: 1 = deposit, 2 = withdrawal.

fields.name: replay_key
docs: Opaque deBridge-owned account used as the replay key.

fields.name: minimum_output
docs: Deposit intents store the six-decimal minimum shares here; withdrawal
intents store the six-decimal minimum native Solana vault assets here.

fields.name: min_output_amount_raw
docs: Authenticated minimum final BNB USDC/USDT output for withdrawals,
encoded as a fixed-width unsigned U256 in big-endian order.

fields.name: actual_output
docs: Actual native share output for the implemented deposit path.

types.name: CrossChainVaultRoute
docs: Per-vault BNB route owned directly by the Gamma program.

fields.name: escrowed_shares
docs: Native shares received from dePort but not yet consumed by a bound
Gamma-withdrawal/DLN-return implementation.

fields.name: beneficiary
docs: Authenticated external-call payload and final BNB recipient.

fields.name: min_vault_assets
docs: Minimum six-decimal native Solana vault assets after Gamma fees.

fields.name: min_output_amount_raw
docs: Minimum final BNB output in 18-decimal raw units, fixed-width U256 BE.

fields.name: min_vault_assets
docs: Six-decimal native Solana vault-asset floor.

fields.name: min_output_amount_raw
docs: Unsigned U256 big-endian final BNB USDC/USDT floor (18 decimals).

types.name: DepositPolicy
docs: Per-vault deposit controls shared by every deposit source, including
Solana-native users and cross-chain adapters.
This is intentionally a separate PDA rather than a field on `LpVault` so
existing vault accounts do not require a layout migration. Existing vaults
fail closed after the program upgrade until their policy PDA is initialized
by the fund authority.

fields.name: lp_vault
docs: Vault this policy belongs to.

fields.name: capacity_assets
docs: Maximum post-deposit NAV in the vault asset's base units.

fields.name: deposits_paused
docs: Emergency switch for deposits. Withdrawals do not consult this field.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA derivation bump.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

fields.name: super_admin
docs: Key with the ability to update the GlobalConfig. Rotatable only via
`update_admin_authorities` (gated on the program upgrade authority).

fields.name: permissioned_creation
docs: When true InitializeLpVault requires create_authority to be a signer

fields.name: create_authority
docs: The key with authority to call `InitializeLpVault`

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump for increased efficiency.

fields.name: assets_account
docs: USDC TokenAccount where users deposit, funds agent operations.

fields.name: pending_shares_account
docs: TokenAccount where shares are held during queued (illiquid) withdrawals.

fields.name: shares_mint
docs: Derived mint (created on initialize) that represents LP tokens or shares.

fields.name: assets_mint
docs: Mint corresponding to the asset, most of the time USDC.

fields.name: fund_authority
docs: Pubkey authorized to withdraw assets from assets_account and update NAV.

fields.name: nav
docs: Current Net Asset Value (total vault value in asset decimals).

fields.name: total_shares
docs: Total shares outstanding (cached for efficiency). May temporarily diverge
from shares_mint.supply during the escrow withdrawal flow (between
fulfill_withdrawal and complete_withdrawal).

fields.name: nav_updated_at
docs: Timestamp for when NAV was last updated.

fields.name: nav_max_staleness
docs: Maximum NAV staleness for user operations (in seconds).
Deposits and withdrawals fail if NAV is older than this.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA derivation bump, stored for CU saving purposes.

fields.name: pending_withdrawal_value
docs: Total value of pending withdrawals awaiting liquidity.
When a withdrawal cannot be fulfilled instantly due to insufficient
liquid assets, the value is tracked here. This is approximate — the
value recorded at withdrawal time may differ from the value at
fulfillment time (recomputed at current NAV). Used for operator
visibility only, not for critical calculations.

fields.name: fee_recipient
docs: Shares token account that receives fee shares. Pubkey::default() = disabled.

fields.name: performance_fee_bps
docs: Performance fee rate in basis points (2000 = 20%). 0 = disabled.

fields.name: assessment_interval_secs
docs: How often scheduled fees are assessed (seconds). E.g., 86400 = 24h.

fields.name: last_assessment_timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp of last fee event (scheduled or withdrawal-triggered).

fields.name: price_per_share_at_last_assessment
docs: PPS at last fee event, scaled by PRICE_SCALE. High-water mark for fees.

fields.name: keeper_authority
docs: Optional keeper authority. When set (non-default), this key can call
fulfill_withdrawal in addition to fund_authority. Allows the keeper
process to use a separate key from the agent/fund_authority.
Pubkey::default() = not set (only fund_authority can fulfill).

types.name: WithdrawEscrow
docs: Escrow account that holds assets and shares for a pending withdrawal.
Each user has one escrow per vault, derived as PDA from [WITHDRAW_ESCROW_SEED, user, vault].

fields.name: user
docs: User who owns this escrow.

fields.name: lp_vault
docs: The vault this escrow is associated with.

fields.name: escrow_assets_account
docs: Token account holding escrowed assets (USDC).

fields.name: escrow_shares_account
docs: Token account holding escrowed shares (for burning on claim).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA derivation bump.

fields.name: user
docs: User requesting withdrawal.

fields.name: lp_vault
docs: Vault where the user has invested.

fields.name: pending_shares
docs: Shares waiting for liquidity (keeper needs to fulfill these).
These shares are held in the escrow_shares_account.

fields.name: claimable_shares
docs: Shares that have been fulfilled and are ready to claim.
These shares are also in escrow_shares_account, waiting to be burned on claim.

fields.name: claimable_assets
docs: Asset value ready to claim (held in escrow_assets_account).

fields.name: oldest_pending_at
docs: Timestamp of the earliest pending withdrawal (for NAV staleness checks).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA derivation bump, stored for CU saving purposes.

fields.name: lp_vault
docs: Vault this policy belongs to.

fields.name: withdrawal_fee_bps
docs: Base-asset fee retained in the vault on withdrawal. 30 = 0.30%.

fields.name: hourly_withdrawal_cap_bps
docs: Max net withdrawal accepted per hour as bps of current NAV. 0 = disabled.

fields.name: daily_withdrawal_cap_bps
docs: Max net withdrawal accepted per day as bps of current NAV. 0 = disabled.

fields.name: hourly_withdrawn_assets
docs: Net withdrawn assets counted in the current hourly window.

fields.name: daily_withdrawn_assets
docs: Net withdrawn assets counted in the current daily window.

fields.name: hourly_window_start
docs: Start timestamp for the current hourly cap window.

fields.name: daily_window_start
docs: Start timestamp for the current daily cap window.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA derivation bump.
